questions.question: What will be the smallest natural number to be filled in the blank for the number ’23_45678’ to be divisible by 22?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

The number is 23_45678

Divisible by 22

**Concept Used:**

The divisibility rule of 11 is the difference between the sum of the odd place of a number and the sum of even place is equal to 0 or 11

The divisibility rule of 2 is the last digit of the number must be divisible by 2

**CALCULATIONS:-**

**Let the blank place digit is x**

If a number is divisible by 22 then the number also divisible by 2 and 11

Then the divisibility rule of 2 is the last digit of the number must be divisible by 2

The last digit of the number is divisible by 2

It satisfies the divisibility rule of 2

 For the divisibility rule of 11

⇒ Sum of digits of odd place = 2 + x + 5 + 7 = 14 + x

⇒ Sum of digits of even place = 3 + 4 + 6 + 8 = 21

The difference is,

⇒ 21 - (14 + x) = either 0 or 11

For 0

⇒ 21 - (14 + x) = 0

⇒ 21 - 14 - x = 0

⇒ x=7

For 11

⇒ 21 - (14 + x) = 11

⇒ 21 - 14 - x = 11

⇒ x = 7 - 11

⇒ x = -4

The digit cannot be negative

⇒ x = 7

**Hence, The smallest natural number to be filled in the blank is 7**

questions.question: If the sum of two numbers is 25 and their product is 144, then what is the positive difference between the two numbers?
questions.solution:

The sum of the two numbers is 25

Their product is 144

Formula used:

(a - b)² = (a + b)² - 4ab

Calculation:

We have

x + y = 25 -----(1) 

⇒ xy = 144 -----(2)

By using the above identity

(x - y)² = (x + y)² - 4xy

(x - y)2 = (25)2 - 4 × 144

(x - y)2 = 625 - 576

(x - y)² = 49

(x - y) = 7

**∴ The answer is 7.**

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 24 days and B can do it in 80 days. B works alone for 2 days and A works alone on the 3rd day. This process continues till the work is completed. In how many days will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:** 

A = 24 days 

B = 80 days

B works alone for 2 days and A works alone on the 3rd day 

**Formula Used:**

Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

A = 24 days

B = 80 days

B works alone for 2 days and A works alone on the 3rd day.

Work completed in 3 days = 2× (1)/(80)+(1)/(24)

Work completed in 3 days = (1)/(40)+(1)/(24)=(3+5)/(120)=(8)/(120)=(1)/(15)

Work completed in 3 days = 15 units 

Total work is completed in = 3× 15=45 days

 

**∴ the whole work is completed in 45 days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** **Time Work Efficiency 

⇒ A 24 240 10 

⇒ B 80 240 3 

B works alone for 2 days and A works alone on the 3rd day

work done in 3 days = 3 + 3 + 10 = 16

⇒ T = 240/16

⇒ T = 15 times

⇒ T = 15 × 3

⇒ T = 45 days 

**∴ The time taken to complete the task is 45 days.**

questions.question: The difference between the simple interest and compound interest on ₹1,000 for 1 year at 20% per annum, compounded half-yearly, is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P=1000, R=20%, T= 1year

**Formula used:**

SI = (P× R× T)/(100)

A = P(1+(R)/(100))^T

P= Principal

R= Rate of interest

T= Time

A = Amount

**Calculation:**

for compounded half-yearly, the rate gets halved and time gets doubled

⇒ R = 20/2

⇒ R = 10%

⇒ T = 1 × 2

⇒ T = 2 years

For SI

⇒ SI = (P× R× T)/(100)

⇒ SI = (1000×10×2)/(100)

⇒ SI = Rs. 200

For CI

⇒ A = P(1+(R)/(100))^T=1000(1+(10)/(100))²

⇒ A = 1000(1+(1)/(10))²

⇒ A = 1000((11)/(10) × (11)/(10))

⇒ A = Rs. 1210

⇒ I = A - P

⇒ I = 1210-1000

 

⇒ I = Rs. 210

Difference = CI - SI

⇒ 210-200

⇒ Rs.10

**∴ The answer is Rs. 10.**

questions.question: Nikhil suffers a loss of ₹140 when he sells a perfume at 20% discount. Find the marked price of the perfume if the cost price is ₹380.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Cost Price (CP)** = ₹380 and **Loss** = ₹140.

**Selling Price (SP)** = CP − Loss = 380 − 140 = ₹240.

Since a **20% discount** is given on the **Marked Price (MP)**, SP = 80% of MP.

80% of MP = ₹240 ⇒ 100% of MP = (240 ÷ 80) × 100 = 3 × 100 = ₹300.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹300.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** CP = ₹380, Loss = ₹140, Discount% = 20%.

**Formulas:** SP = CP − Loss | MP = SP × 100 ÷ (100 − Discount%)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/980c5c1b282c19fb384a4de82dd0ddf81268929cc148e7a3e2edb00283e67f89.png] 

⇒ Step 1: Calculate **Selling Price (SP)** = CP − Loss = 380 − 140 = 240.

⇒ Step 2: Relate SP to **Marked Price (MP)**. SP = MP × (1 − 20/100) = MP × 0.8.

⇒ Step 3: MP = 240 ÷ 0.8 = 300.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹300.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

**Discount** is always calculated on the **Marked Price (MP)**. Formula: SP = MP − Discount.

Loss and Selling Price

When **Cost Price (CP)** is greater than **Selling Price (SP)**, a loss occurs. Formula: Loss = CP − SP.

questions.question:
A sphere passes through the eight corners of a cube of side 14 cm. Find the volume (in cm³) of the sphere.

Take π = 22/7
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a sphere circumscribing a cube, its diameter is equal to the body diagonal of the cube.

Diameter = a√3 = 14√3 cm ⇒ Radius (r) = 7√3 cm.

Volume of the sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × (7√3)³ = 4312√3 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 4312√3 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of the cube (a) = 14 cm

**Formula Used:**

Diameter of a circumscribed sphere (D) = Body diagonal of the cube = a√3

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/871811a8c22964c9dec277659ec87617667d63282357c6af79eafa52cb26dd99.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Diameter of the sphere (D) = 14√3 cm

⇒ Radius of the sphere (r) = D ÷ 2 = 7√3 cm

⇒ Volume of the sphere = (4/3) × (22/7) × (7√3)³

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × (343 × 3√3)

⇒ Volume = 4 × 22 × 49 × √3

⇒ Volume = 88 × 49 × √3

⇒ Volume = 4312√3 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 4312√3 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sphere Circumscribing a Cube

The sphere passes through all eight vertices of the cube. Its diameter is equal to the body diagonal: D = a√3.

Sphere Inscribed in a Cube

The sphere touches all six faces of the cube. Its diameter is equal to the side length of the cube: D = a.

Key Mensuration Formulas

Total Surface Area of a Cube = 6a² | Total Surface Area of a Sphere = 4πr².

Rate × quantity = total cost

Then, xy = 240 

After the new price, 1.25x(y-1.5)=240

Substituting y=(240)/(x) and solving for x,

1.25xleft ((240)/(x)-1.5)=240

1.25×240-1.25× 1.5x=240

x=(60)/(1.25 × 1.5)=32

125% of 32 = 1.25 × 32 = 40

**∴ The increased price of the sugar is Rs. 40 per kg.**
